category_title: High school students with learning disabilities and ADHD who struggle to break down multi-step algebraic tasks
scenario_title: Faulty self-evaluation and reliance on teacher confirmation
minimal_context: The student is transitioning from using Algebra Lab Gear to using abstract symbols with the Box Method during a one-on-one instructional session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For this next problem, let's transition away from the Algebra Lab Gear and try using abstract symbols only with the Box Method.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not good at that. I don't know if I am doing this right.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just write down your steps in the boxes and see what you get.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay, I filled in the abstract symbols, but I know I messed up the solution.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look at the work you just did. What do you think?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is all wrong (handing me her paper). You aren't even helping me!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: For this next problem, let's transition away from the Algebra Lab Gear and try using abstract symbols only with the Box Method.

task.content: Transitioning from the ALG to using abstract symbols only with the Box Method
task.learning_goal: Accurately completing tasks using abstract symbols and evaluating own solutions

context.materials: Box Method graphic organizer, abstract symbols, Algebra Lab Gear (ALG)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: After accurately completing a task but needing confirmation from the teacher before acknowledging success
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Made faulty evaluations of the accuracy of her solutions, handed her paper to the teacher saying it was wrong, and accused the teacher of not helping her when encouraged to use tools
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Lacked confidence in her own accurate solutions, feeling surprised by her success
related_quotes: I don’t know if I am doing this right
This is all wrong (handing me her paper)

behavior_patterns.condition: When encouraged to rely on the tools more than the teacher for confirmation
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Was resistant and accused the teacher of not helping her
